name: Amazon CloudWatch
summary: Send Ogun metrics to Amazon CloudWatch Metrics and events to CloudWatch Logs, signed with Signature Version 4.

fields.name: secret_access_key
fields.label: Secret access key
fields.help: Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

auth.label: IAM role of the exporter host

settings.name: log_group
settings.label: Log group
settings.help: The group that receives the events. It must exist.

notes: Metrics, to CloudWatch Metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events, to CloudWatch Logs: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.
